description: [Ncloud Storage] Upload a text object to a Ncloud Storage bucket (PUT /{key}). Optional storage class (STANDARD (default): Standard Class | ONEZONE_IA: One Zone-IA (Infrequent Access) Class | DEEP_ARCHIVE: Archive Class), server-side encryption and Object Lock headers. Use dryRun=true to preview.

body.description: Content to upload as the object body

bucketName.description: Name of the Ncloud Storage bucket

dryRun.description: If true (default), returns a preview without actually uploading

key.description: Object key (path) to upload to, e.g. 'folder/file.txt'

objectLockMode.description: x-amz-object-lock-mode — GOVERNANCE | COMPLIANCE (bucket must have Object Lock enabled; give objectLockRetainUntilDate too)

storageClass.description: x-amz-storage-class — STANDARD (default): Standard Class | ONEZONE_IA: One Zone-IA (Infrequent Access) Class | DEEP_ARCHIVE: Archive Class. Omit to use STANDARD

name: ncloud_ncs_put_object
